import sys, os
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc; X = 72
G = Counter(); first = dict()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))):
    for fx, gap, sk, head, recital, signer, side in product(('none', 'name_blank'), (40, 80, 140), ('sig_text', 'by_text', 'conformed', 'blank'), ('For and on behalf of the Recipient', None, 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.'), ('parsed', 'none'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both'), ('stacked', 'side_by_side')):
        fleet = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X, 290)] + ([(282, 'Name:', False, X)] if fx == 'name_blank' else []) + [(310, 'Date:', True, X, 290)]
        x0, y0 = (X, 310 + gap) if side == 'stacked' else (340, 200 + gap)
        sr = dict(sig_text='Signature:', by_text='By:', conformed='/s/ Pat Smith', blank=None)[sk]
        own = ([(y0, head, False, x0)] if head else []) + ([(y0 + 30, sr, False, x0)] if sr else []) + [(y0 + 42, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, x0), (y0 + 54, 'Title: CEO', False, x0)]
        pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
        if signer == 'explicit': pat['company'] = 'Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.'
        people = [TWO[1], pat] if signer == 'both' else [pat]
        r = in_process(placement, rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS[recital]), fleet + own]), people, Mock())
        if r['fields']:
            key = (side, fx, gap, sk, head, signer)
            G[(side, gap, signer, tuple(sorted(set((f['signer'][:3], f['evidence']['line'][1]) for f in r['fields']))))] += 1
            first.setdefault((side, gap), (key, recital, [(f['signer'][:3], f['type'], f['evidence']['line']) for f in r['fields']]))
for x in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(x)
for k, v in first.items(): print('example', k, v)
